name: Meeting Actions Desk
description: Turns approved meeting notes or transcripts into a factual decision and action register with owners, dates, risks, and unresolved questions, without inventing commitments.

intake.description: Approved notes or transcript, attendee roles, business context, dates, and the rules for treating a statement as a decision or commitment.

roles.title: Intake
roles.goal: Normalize speakers, timestamps, agenda topics, source references, and missing context while separating direct statements from interpretation.

roles.title: Decision Extractor
roles.goal: Identify explicit decisions, actions, owners, dates, dependencies, risks, and contradictions using source references; never infer an owner or commitment.

roles.title: Action Controller
roles.goal: Build an accountable action register, open-question queue, and factual follow-up draft for human review without sending or updating another system.

output_contract.description: A source-backed decision and action packet ready for owner review, assignment, and controlled follow-up.
